perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals
observations: Primary evidence confirms the Sept. 17 Antares multi-year HALEU contract is binding, includes prepayments and targets deliveries before decade-end for advanced-reactor, space and national-security use.
Radiant and DOE commitments provide demand plus public-capital support rather than a single-customer signal; no repeat search was needed because these sources are current and source-addressed.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution
observations: The July DOE contract and completed additional 900 kg HALEU UF6 are concrete execution evidence beyond prospective demand.
Commercial-scale delivery economics and schedule remain future tests; contracts and prepayments reduce demand uncertainty but do not prove margins or ramp execution.
